notes: Generate a JPEG master for every entry, 1280x720 or larger, 16:9, photorealistic, as if shot on a camera. No cartoons, illustrations, flat vector, or stylised art. No faces and no real identifiable people. No company logos, wordmarks, or readable brand names. Do not stage a press conference, signing, protest, or other news event. New-story posts are draft:true until these masters exist and npm run art has been run. src/_data/imageSizes.json contains temporary dimension stubs (pending:true) so Eleventy can render those drafts; npm run art rewrites that file from JPEGs on disk, so add every master before running art or the draft build will fail again. The two Claude Duet inline files are temporary copies of the story hero so the published page builds; replace those JPEGs with the photographs described here, then rerun npm run art. Their alt text describes the photographs to generate, not the temporary copies.
